project_info.theme: Techcombank Sinh Loi Tu Dong U-Point conversion feature
project_info.color_palette: Vibrant red, white, black, soft coral, orange-yellow highlights

main_subject.detail: A bright red app-feature poster with the top-right lockup 'TECHCOMBANK' and 'SINH LOI TU DONG'. Large white headline text reads 'Dieu chinh han muc quy doi tien loi sang U-Point'. In the center is an oversized white smartphone with a glowing edge. A cute rounded white mascot face with black glossy visor-like eyes sits on the phone, surrounded by orange coin droplets and a red U-point token. A black rounded rectangle banner across the phone says 'Nap U-Point bang loi nhuan, nhan X2 diem'. Bottom-left copy reads 'MOI NGAY THEM GIA TRI!'.
main_subject.style: Playful fintech feature poster with glossy 3D mascot, app-device hero composition, and bold red brand field

prompt.generated_prompt_string: High quality advertising poster for a Techcombank Sinh Loi Tu Dong U-Point conversion feature. Centerpiece is a large glowing white smartphone containing a cute white rounded mascot with dark glossy eyes, floating orange coin droplets, and a red U-point token. Background is a vivid red gradient with translucent diamond overlays and sparkle stars. Surrounding elements: Techcombank logo, 'SINH LOI TU DONG', exact headline 'Dieu chinh han muc quy doi tien loi sang U-Point', black banner 'Nap U-Point bang loi nhuan, nhan X2 diem', and bottom-left line 'MOI NGAY THEM GIA TRI!'. Technical style: 3D fintech app poster with polished brand-asset rendering, bold digital-commercial lighting, phone edge glow and glossy reflections, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
